items.title: Measure learner employment outcomes (CB → DH pipeline)
items.current_state: No tracking. 10 modules live, unknown where graduates end up.
items.gap: Do CB learners actually get hired by contractors (Deadhang, similar)? At what rate? What skills matter most?
items.why_it_matters: Without proof of outcomes, CB is just content. With outcomes, it's a talent pipeline validating the business model.
items.research_needed: Track 20-30 CB learners for 6 months: measure who books gigs, via which platforms, at what rate, in which roles.
items.notes: This is the lynchpin of the entire ecosystem. If CB graduates don't get hired, nothing else matters.

items.title: Measure learner engagement and completion rates
items.current_state: Module completion tracked client-side (localStorage), no backend analytics.
items.gap: Which modules have highest drop-off? Which lessons confuse learners? What's typical time-to-completion?
items.why_it_matters: Engagement metrics inform content prioritization and quality improvements.
items.research_needed: Implement analytics tracking (time-on-page, lesson completion patterns, re-engagement rate, quiz pass rates by question).

items.title: Validate free→paid conversion funnel
items.current_state: Pricing hypothesis exists ($29-49 module, $79-129 pathway). No data on actual conversion.
items.gap: Do learners actually upgrade from free to paid? At what conversion rate? Which pricing tier converts best?
items.why_it_matters: Unblocks revenue model validation and enables funding for content expansion.
items.research_needed: Track signup→upgrade funnel for 60 days: measure free users, trial takers, paid conversions, churn rate.

items.title: Map pathway alignment to real job opportunities (CB ↔ FA)
items.current_state: CB has 5 pathways (Lighting, Video, Audio, Staging, Backline). FA has 8-9 departments researched. No mapping.
items.gap: Do CB's pathways match the opportunities FA publishes? Are there gaps (e.g., FA shows Rigging demand but CB has no Rigging pathway)?
items.why_it_matters: Learner should see: finish Lighting pathway → browse Lighting opportunities on FA → apply. If paths don't align, learner confusion.
items.research_needed: Map CB pathways to FA departments side-by-side. Identify content gaps. Rank by: job market demand, learner interest, pay rates.

items.title: Measure community demand for branded merchandise (CB ↔ Shirts)
items.current_state: Shirts designs exist. Zero sales, zero community signal.
items.gap: Do CB learners actually want Stagehand/Rigging/etc. branded merchandise? Would they buy?
items.why_it_matters: If Shirts revenue is viable, it funds CB expansion. If not viable, Shirts stays speculative.
items.research_needed: Survey 50+ CB learners: 'Would you buy Stagehand-branded [shirt/merch]?' Measure willingness to pay, design preference.

items.title: Identify crew quality signals (what makes a good contractor)
items.current_state: CB curriculum designed by research and industry interviews, not by real contractor feedback.
items.gap: When Deadhang hires crew members, what skills/mindset show up first? What training gaps emerge?
items.why_it_matters: CB curriculum should be shaped by what DH and similar contractors actually need. Prevents training-job mismatch.
items.research_needed: DH tracks first 3 crew hires: document skill gaps, safety issues, communication patterns. Feedback loop to CB.
